newsitem.title: MEXICO: Three Russians die in Mexico road accident.
newsitem.headline: Three Russians die in Mexico road accident.

text.p: Two Russian diplomats and a Russian visitor died in a road accident while touring northern Mexico, officials said on Tuesday.
The accident occured on Monday in coastal Sinaloa state on a road between Culiacan and the Pacific resort of Mazatlan about 750 miles (1,200 km) northwest of Mexico City, state police said.
The car carrying the three Russians collided with a truck carrying cargo in circumstances that are still under investigation, police said.

A spokesman for the Russian embassy in Mexico City identified the deceased as counsellor Alexandre Kikevitch and administrative official Evgueni Kostikov of the embassy, and Alexandre Anekcahap, a guest of the two diplomats.
